senses.gloss: to cut off (denom. חוּטְרָא I, twig, cmp. גֶּזַע &c.). &c.).

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 19:8">Targ. Job XIX, 8</cite>.—Denom. <cite ref="H00304"><he>חוּטְרָא</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:9">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>בלועא דחמרא חֲטַרְתֵּיה</he> (Ms. M. <he>חטבתיה</he>) with an ass’ jaw I should strike him.

senses.gloss: to provide with a vertical stroke (חוּטְרָא).
units: <cite ref="Menachot 29b:6">Men. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>דחַטְּרֵי להו לגגיה דחי״ת</he> (Ms. M. <he>דהוו חַטְרֵי ליה</he> Pe.) they used to put a vertical stroke on the roof of the Ḥeth.
